name: creator-gacha
description: Dev harness only — the shipped app is plain ES modules with zero dependencies and no build step. Vitest runs the test suite against the pure core. The match room and the matchmaking queue are Durable Objects, so a live arena needs TWO terminals: `dev:room` hosts the objects, `dev` serves the site bound to them. `dev:static` is static-only and correctly reports no lobby.

scripts.dev: npx wrangler pages dev . --do ROOM=MatchRoom@creator-gacha-room --do QUEUE=MatchQueue@creator-gacha-room --compatibility-date=2026-08-15
scripts.deploy: node tools/build-set.js && node tools/build-site.js && npx wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=creator-gacha --branch=main && node tools/record-deploy.js
scripts.deploy:filtered: node tools/build-set.js --apply-staged && node tools/build-site.js && npx wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=creator-gacha --branch=main && node tools/record-deploy.js
